name: Early Javanese wayang in inscription
description: An inscription dated 907 CE attests the term wayang in Java, a historical witness to a continuing performance tradition.

impact.note: A single inscription that merely attests the word wayang; the tradition did not descend from this text.

date.label: 907 CE
date.basis: Wright cites an inscription issued by King Balitung dated 907 CE.

events.scope: Wright is secondary evidence; the inscription was not independently read. Its terminology does not establish that the 907 performance had the precise materials, staging or repertoire of modern shadow-puppet theatre, nor the origin of wayang.
events.caveats: Wright is secondary evidence; the inscription was not independently read. Its terminology does not establish that the 907 performance had the precise materials, staging or repertoire of modern shadow-puppet theatre, nor the origin of wayang.
